review.recipe: One ice-full Collins, clear gold liquid, one orange peel inside, no foam or cherry. Blue bowl visibly empty. Jaggery fragment too shiny/crystalline rather than matte crumbly cane sugar.
review.personality: Released folder clasp and cream handkerchief are present but far too spread out: essential union x803–1578 is 775px; the full handkerchief cannot survive a roughly 434px tall-phone window. Bundle is an opened table cloth rather than a compact gripped pocket handkerchief.
review.world: Warm historic reading-room light and dark walnut. Broad ice faces and long-grain timber improve on v5, but drink still has dense granular bubbles/droplets and leather an exaggerated crackle sheen; no final anti-AI acceptance.
